status: Exploratory study, separate from the thesis and reviewer responses

dishonest_sweep.behaviour: The first f witnesses always report positive, including when the scene predicate is false or the patch is invisible. They cannot forge the geometric ranges.

visibility_sweep.heading: Each witness faces the zone centre; the queried scene patch is at the prover's x,y and height zero.

observation_model.truth: Whether a red car is present in the queried patch; absent cases use the same patch geometry.
observation_model.common_errors: For each independent trial, with probability c use one shared uniform draw for all witness errors; otherwise use separate uniform draws. Marginal error probabilities stay fixed. For equal error probabilities, raw pairwise error correlation equals c.
observation_model.missing: Use a separate, independent mixture for unavailable observations. Invisible or unavailable patches produce UNKNOWN, not a negative report.
observation_model.geometry: Visibility requires both 3-D range and horizontal field of view. Occlusion is represented by the declared missing-observation process, not a rendered scene.
observation_model.pairing: Reuse the same random input arrays across all conditions and rules. Select the single-witness index uniformly before any observation, independently for every trial.
observation_model.time: Independent static snapshot trials; no temporal-error process or network simulation.

decision.admit: At least k positive contextual reports from witnesses passing range and RF.
decision.inconclusive: Admission is not reached, but unknown reports from otherwise eligible witnesses could change the result. This is a diagnostic category; deployment remains fail-closed.
decision.reject: Even making all unknown reports positive cannot reach k.
decision.insufficient_observations: Fewer than k witnesses in the rule have known contextual reports, independently of range/RF eligibility.
decision.validity: Truthful context at a stated position is not automatically within the service region. Boundary plots show admission of truthful claims, not a universal false-rejection rate.

validation: Common-offset RF formula agrees with the corrected simulator.
Replay sampled decisions through upstream policy and quorum code.
Conditional analytical binomial-mixture expectations for every contextual condition and rule.
Nested quorum decisions and no-context baselines.
Repeat execution with identical seed, inputs and outputs.

reporting.intervals: Pointwise 95% Wilson intervals for independent synthetic trials; not simultaneous intervals or uncertainty about real sensors.
reporting.baseline: Range-only and range-plus-RF admission use the identical geometric/RF samples as contextual policies.
claims_excluded: Empirical calibration of input error rates
